<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919663_theRebbe_89" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919663_theRebbe_89__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through service in all three lines, in earlier generations this brought a figurative redemption, but now that all clarifications are complete, engaging in Torah, charity, and communal prayer brings actual redemption, specifically the "redeem in peace" of the future redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">a)</t>
    <t s="2">And through the service in all three lines,</t>
    <t s="3">behold, in previous generations, through this it was as if "He redeemed me"</t>
    <t s="4">(with a "kaf" of comparison),</t>
    <t s="5">and this is in the manner explained in Iggeret HaKodesh88</t>
    <t s="6">regarding the matter of individual redemption.</t>
    <t s="7">However, now, since "behold, He stands behind our wall," and as is known the talk of the Baal HaGeulah</t>
    <t s="8">(10-12 Tammuz),</t>
    <t s="9">that all the clarifications have already been completed and only a "tsuptsen di kneplach"89 is needed,</t>
    <t s="10">behold now,</t>
    <t s="11">through engaging in Torah, acts of kindness, and prayer with the community, it will be "He redeemed me," etc., literally,</t>
    <t s="12">and in the manner of "He redeemed my soul in peace,"</t>
    <t s="13">for the true essence of the matter of "redeem in peace" will be specifically at the coming of Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="14">as explained by the Mitteler Rebbe90.</t>
    <t s="15">And this is also what the Alter Rebbe wrote</t>
    <t s="16">(in his Iggeret HaKodesh upon his return from Petersburg91)</t>
    <t s="17">"And when I read in the book of Tehillim the verse 'He redeemed my soul in peace'... I went out in peace from 'Hashem Shalom,'"</t>
    <t s="18">for it is known92</t>
    <t s="19">that the essential matter of "Your springs will spread outward" began after [the year] 5562.</t>
    <t s="20">And therefore he went out in peace when he read the verse "He redeemed my soul in peace,"</t>
    <t s="21">for</t>
    <t s="22">(the essential)</t>
    <t s="23">matter of "redeem in peace" is in the future redemption</t>
    <t s="24">(as above),</t>
    <t s="25">and "Your springs will spread outward" is the preparation93</t>
    <t s="26">for this,</t>
    <t s="27">"until the Master comes."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through this he opened and paved the way so that each person can and must engage in this preparation and bring the redemption by doing what depends on him, as per the Rambam's ruling that one action tips the scales and brings salvation, actualizing "He redeemed my soul in peace" in the true and complete redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And through this he opened and paved the way,</t>
    <t s="1">so that each and every one can</t>
    <t s="2">(and therefore must)</t>
    <t s="3">engage in this preparation and bring the redemption, by doing what depends on him, as per the ruling of the Rambam94</t>
    <t s="4">that through one action</t>
    <t s="5">(whether in deed,</t>
    <t s="6">speech, or thought)</t>
    <t s="7">he tips himself and the entire world to the scale of merit and causes for himself and them salvation and deliverance,</t>
    <t s="8">so that "He redeemed my soul in peace" is actualized,</t>
    <t s="9">"He redeemed me and my children from among the nations,"</t>
    <t s="10">very soon and in our time,</t>
    <t s="11">in the true and complete redemption through Moshiach Tzidkeinu.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
